race.comment: KEEP IT LOKI (6) was allowed to drift back from a wide draw last time before finding the line strongly to score by a nose over 1400m at Gold Coast. Will prove tough to hold out again. DARK STRATUM (4) improved last time out to score by a head after leading them up on the turn over 1412m at Taree. Finds a suitable race and can get the job done again. MONARCH EXPRESS (10) hasn't made an impression lately despite market confidence. Last start could only manage fifth over 1430m at Grafton. Top-three prospects. THIEM (15) settled well back from a wide draw last time then wound up strongly to finish fourth over 1200m at Grafton. Was outdashed but got going late and the extra ground looks a big plus. Well placed and is among the chances. BIANCO NERO (16) didn't give her rivals a sniff last start at Inverell when leading all the way. This is tougher but she deserves safe keeping.
